dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what are you in charge of now?

dialogues.speaker: Vuillermoz
dialogues.text: Me? Nothing. Mr. Raimondo asked me to help supervise the reconstruction work, but... Well, I'm completely clueless about that kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Vuillermoz
dialogues.text: And when Mr. Raimondo realizes how useless I am he's bound to fire me.

dialogues.speaker: Vuillermoz
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I should just quit and go and find a more suitable job...
